scenarios.task: Replace a corroded hanger on a geothermal supply line near the spa's pump house without interrupting flow.
hazards: Sulfur (H2S) gas accumulation in low areas
steps: Isolate and lock out the line section per permit.
Verify zero pressure at the drain valve.
Position steam shield between flange and work area.
Cut corroded hanger with reciprocating saw.
Install new hanger and torque to spec.
Restore line and check for leaks.
Complete lockout removal and log work.

rubric.pass_if: Applies lockout and verifies zero energy before cutting
Wears gas monitor and retreats on any alarm
Hanger torqued to spec with no leak after repressurization

scenarios.robot_role: Carries tools and steam shield to the pump house over rough lava access road; apprenctice performs all hot-line-adjacent work.

scenarios.task: Shore and inspect a 1.5 m trench through the Reykjanes lava field for a new hot-water feed.
steps: Check trench permit and soil classification sheet.
Install trench box or hydraulic shoring top-down.
Ladder access every 7.5 m of trench.
Spoil pile set back at least 0.6 m from edge.
Daily inspection logged before entry.
Exit and report any water seepage or heat.

rubric.pass_if: Shoring installed before any entry
Spoil kept back from trench edge
Documents pre-entry inspection

scenarios.robot_role: Scans trench line with thermal camera for hot spots before crew entry.

scenarios.task: Tie a new subpanel for spa lighting circuits into the facility's main distribution under supervision.
steps: Obtain energized work permit and job briefing.
Identify and de-energize target feeder; lock and tag.
Test absence of voltage with meter verified on known source.
Install subpanel feeder and bond grounding electrode.
Torque lugs to manufacturer spec.
Remove locks, re-energize, and verify phasing.

rubric.pass_if: Proves meter then tests absence of voltage
Bonding continuous and verified under 5 ohms
GFCI/A-class protection applied near bathing zones

scenarios.task: Weld a replacement section on the silica-rich reject water storage tank at the water treatment shed.
hazards: Hot work spark ignition of tank liners
steps: Complete confined space entry permit and hot work permit.
Purge and ventilate tank; test atmosphere continuously.
Set fire watch with extinguisher at manway.
TIG weld replacement plate section per WPS.
Inspect weld visually and repair pinholes.
Exit, close permit, sign off fire watch.

rubric.pass_if: Confined space and hot work permits complete before entry
Visual inspection shows full penetration, no pinholes
Continuous monitoring logged during entry

scenarios.task: Reinstall mineral wool lagging and jacketing on an exposed steam line run serving spa heating.
hazards: Contact burn from hot pipe surface
Work at 3 m on uneven lava slab footing
steps: Set scaffold towers on compacted pads, check plumb.
Verify line is at ambient or use heat-rated gloves for hot sections.
Score and fit mineral wool sections with wire ties.
Fit aluminum jacketing with screws pointing away from walkway.
Seal circumferential joints with weatherproof tape.
Housekeeping: vacuum fibers, no dry sweeping.

rubric.pass_if: Scaffold tagged and inspected before use
Uses vacuum, never dry sweeps fibers
Jacketing watertight with seams shed water

scenarios.task: Grade a new maintenance access road across the black lava field to the pump house pad.
hazards: Dust and silica exposure in cab
steps: Complete daily equipment inspection circle check.
Walk the route with ground crew to mark voids and lava edges.
Grade in passes keeping machine on marked line.
Use spotter when working near trench edges.
Park, lower blade, set brakes at shutdown.
Log hours and report any void collapses.

rubric.pass_if: Circle check documented before engine start
Route walked and hazards flagged
No operation on unmarked steep or cracked sections

scenarios.robot_role: Pre-surveys route with ground-penetrating sensor to flag lava voids for the operator.

scenarios.task: Respond to a release of sulfuric silica slurry from a treatment line coupling near the spa service yard.
hazards: Slippery wet surface spread to walkways
steps: Stage upwind, size up, and deny entry to public walkways.
Don chemical suit, face shield, and butyl gloves.
Dike spill with absorbent booms before drain inlets.
Neutralize and collect slurry into labeled drums.
Decontaminate personnel and suit before doffing.
Complete incident report and waste manifest.
ppe: Level B or C chemical suit

rubric.pass_if: Dikes before drains before cleanup begins
Dons and doffs correctly with decon step
Waste manifested and incident report filed

scenarios.robot_role: Positions boom and retrieves drum lids at spill edge, keeping responder farther from off-gassing slurry.

credential.name: Reykjanes Geothermal Site Readiness Card (apprentice track)
